name: cli-options
title: Add CLI options without breaking defaults
prompt:
`report.py` is a CLI: `python report.py data.json` prints students sorted by grade (highest first),
one per line as `name: grade`.

Add two options:
- `--limit N`: print only the first N lines (default: all). N must be >= 1, otherwise argparse must
  reject it (exit code 2).
- `--min-grade X`: only include students with grade >= X (default: no filter).
The default output (no options) must stay exactly the same.
